summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration that defines a service called 'app' which builds a Docker image from the current directory and runs it as a container. It sets up user IDs for the container, mounts the local project folder into the container at /opt/behat, and names the container using a template variable.

explanations.1: This disables spell-checking for this YAML file so that technical terms won't trigger spell-check warnings.
explanations.6: The 'args' section passes build arguments to the Dockerfile, which are like variables the Dockerfile can use during the image build process.
explanations.8: DOCKER_UID=1000 sets the user ID for processes running in the container to 1000, matching a typical Linux user ID to avoid file permission issues.
explanations.9: DOCKER_GID=1000 sets the group ID for the container user, ensuring the container user belongs to a group with ID 1000.
explanations.12: The container_name uses '%%name=php-app%%' which is a template placeholder that will be replaced with an actual name when this compose file is processed.
explanations.16: This mounts your current project folder (the ./) as a volume inside the container at /opt/behat, so changes you make locally are immediately visible inside the container.
